story.head: Draisaitl’s favorite opponent
paras: The Oilers won the teams’ first meeting this season, 3-1 in Edmonton on Oct 3. The Kraken (10-8-1) beat Vancouver 5-1 on Nov 19, while the Oilers (17-4-3) lost 3-1 to Tampa Bay the same night. This is a Pacific Division matchup, with the Kraken fifth (tied for 23rd in the NHL) and the Oilers first (second). The Pacific has been the weakest of the four divisions so far.

The Kraken’s record (.553) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.430), largely thanks to their finishing. So is the Oilers’ (.771 on chances worth .560), largely thanks to their finishing.

The Kraken rarely threaten on the penalty kill (32nd) and give up a lot of shots (32nd). They also have a leaky penalty kill (31st), so the Oilers’ power play (1st) could do real damage when they’re shorthanded. On the other side, the Oilers have the league’s most dangerous power play (1st) and play slow, tight games (3rd lowest). They also lean hard on their top players (lowest), so the Kraken roll four lines, but they lean on their top six. Edmonton has scored 3.83 goals a game, the third most in the league.

Berkly Catton (8 G / 9 A / 17 P in 19 GP) leads the Kraken in scoring, and Brandon Montour (3 G / 11 A / 14 P in 18 GP) isn’t far behind. Connor McDavid (13 G / 42 A / 55 P in 24 GP) leads the Oilers and the whole NHL in scoring, with seven points in his last five games and eight goals in eleven games against Seattle since 2023-24. Leon Draisaitl (21 G / 23 A / 44 P in 24 GP) has a team-high 21 goals, tied for the most in the NHL, with eight points in his last five games.

Devon Levi (10-2-0 / .902 SV% in 12 GS) will likely start for Edmonton. Seattle has two options in net: Philipp Grubauer (6-4-1 / .897 SV% in 10 GS) and Joey Daccord (4-4-0 / .872 SV% in 9 GS). Grubauer has started six of their last ten games, including the last one on Nov 19. It’s anyone’s guess who gets the net.
At home, Mike Babcock likes to send Dach, McDavid and Hyman out against opponents’ fourth lines, so watch for them against Meyers, Wood and Melanson.

The Oilers are newly without Ryan Nugent-Hopkins, and have been without Frederik Andersen for several games. Devon Levi is expected to start.
The Kraken have been without Jared McCann since Oct 22.
Evan Bouchard has twelve goals on chances worth about 4.7 goals, well above what his finishing usually turns chances into. Runs like that tend to cool off.
